findings.title: Line-validator messages (eventViolations) may quote field values
findings.disposition_rationale: Those messages belong to the existing writers' validators and are out of scope for this slice; the sentinel bar in the spec covers the two schema-validator copies.

findings.title: A corrupt evidence document classifies the anchor as legacy
findings.disposition_rationale: The spec's legacy rule is defined as no present evidence document carrying schema_version, and legacy exits 1 under --require-evidence-schema; slice 6 enforcement owns closing this.

findings.title: Unreadable anchor file crashes instead of reporting
findings.disposition_rationale: Per-file reads now report 'unreadable file' (evidence.js readBytes).

findings.title: Torn-tail definition in logs.md differs from the code
findings.disposition_rationale: logs.md now says the line does not parse as JSON, matching walkPhysicalChain and the code.

findings.title: --selftest short-circuits before positional validation
findings.disposition_rationale: --selftest only runs when no positionals are present.

findings.title: listFiles skips symlinks
findings.disposition_rationale: The mint byte-copies regular files into anchors; a symlink cannot come from the mint.

findings.title: Bundle re-read on every call
findings.disposition_rationale: Cost is trivial today; caching can come with the slice 6 callers.

findings.title: No containment check on manifest schema paths
findings.disposition_rationale: The manifest is a bundled, test-pinned file, not input from an anchor.

findings.title: Test helper spread can mask export collisions
Selftest label does not match its assertion
findings.disposition_rationale: Relabelled to 'the manifest names twelve files'.
